letters.title: Three years
letters.text: Three years, and I still get butterflies when I see your name pop up on my phone.

letters.title: The bus stop
letters.text: I still remember holding your hand on our first date. I never wanted to let go.

letters.title: Your laugh
letters.text: Your laugh is my favourite sound in the whole world. I'd happily spend forever making you laugh.

letters.title: Momos
letters.text: You can have the last momo. You can always have the last momo.

letters.title: Slow dance
letters.text: Our first slow dance at the formal. I'd dance with you a thousand times more.

letters.title: Home
letters.text: Home isn't a place anymore. It's wherever you are.

letters.title: Laufey
letters.text: Watching you sing along at the Palais, I wasn't looking at the stage much at all.

letters.title: Stars
letters.text: That night in Apollo Bay I tried to count the stars. I gave up and just looked at you instead.

letters.title: Thank you
letters.text: Thank you for being patient with me, for believing in me, and for making every day softer.

letters.title: Pink hair
letters.text: Pink hair, dark roots, whatever colour comes next — you're beautiful in all of them.

letters.title: Little things
letters.text: I love the little things most: your sleepy voice, your hand finding mine, the way you steal my fries.

letters.title: Campfire
letters.text: Just the two of us, a crackling fire and a sky full of stars. I'd go back there with you any day.

letters.title: High tea
letters.text: Tiny cakes and tiny sandwiches, and the biggest smile across the table. Best date ever.

letters.title: Proud of you
letters.text: I'm so proud of you. Of everything you do, and everything you're going to do.

letters.title: Bad days
letters.text: On your bad days, I'll be here. On your good days, I'll be here too, cheering the loudest.

letters.title: Garden
letters.text: Valentine's Day at the botanic garden: a quiet pond, the boardwalk, and you. Perfect.

letters.title: Lucky
letters.text: Out of everyone in the whole world, I got you. I'm the luckiest person alive.

letters.title: A promise
letters.text: I promise to keep making you laugh, keep holding your hand, and keep choosing you, every day.

letters.title: Our future
letters.text: I can't wait for all the places we haven't been yet, and all the memories we haven't made.

letters.title: I love you
letters.text: I love you, Suzy. Yesterday, today, and every day after. Happy anniversary.
